blocks.html: Until such time that the department by rule adopts revised FEMA FIS 360497 and FEMA FIRMs 360497 with a final effective date later than April 18, 2018, the commissioner shall not deem issuance of a LOMR-F as removing such structure or tax lot from the special flood hazard area unless the elevations specified in the LOMR-F equal or exceed the applicable corresponding elevations on the FEMA PFIS 360497/FEMA PFIRMs 360497.
